author: Kathy Schulte
text: Our well pump stopped working Sunday morning.  We called and left a message and Steve answered!  He was here the same day to diagnose our problem, offered a couple of options on a new pump,  both reasonable after I did a little research.  He replaced our pump the following day!  He was super thorough, replaced any smaller parts needed on our pump system without nickel-and-diming us.  Very rare these days!  You can trust this guy.

author: Lianne Bishop
text: What a wonderful company. Family owned, local knowledge, and full of old school knowledge and respect. Steven was friendly, easy to talk too, and happy to explain and answer questions. He worked with me to find the proper solution for my situation trying the simple fixes before showing me my pump was truly fried. Gotta love lightning. He helped me find the right course for my needs and got me back up and running.  He even made sure my old tank was safe and operational, set properly, and refreshed the connections. They made sure I was good to go and made themselves available for any follow-up needs or questions. So easy to talk with and prices and service were great. I've been in this area a long time and this is the local company to call!! FYI they merged their two family companies so Sunshine and Sweetwater are the same family business.

author: D “Alex” H
text: These guys have saved the day. I had a friend who had just bought a house, and his well had stopped working. He saw the sticker on the pump and gave them a call. They came out that day on the weekend and gave him a quick education on how to operate a well for the first time. They never talked down to him and when they left he felt empowered for the next opportunity. It's such a win-win for everyone. And their finished product is good looking in the back yard for a well.

author: Nichole Gencarelli
text: I would recommend them! What a great company. I had several people come out to my home to check my pump only with give me quotes that were outrageous and not fitting to my needs. I'm a single mother with two kids and just couldn't afford what others where telling me. This company was fantastic, he replaced my well pump and was very kind. I'll be calling again.

author: Rick Sr. Colon
text: Great company! awesome service people and Mr. Steve is always there when call upon.  This company keeps its customers satisfied with great service and best equipment installed. If you are looking to install water filters and salt tanks this company goes beyond satisfactory. It’s like having a good friend to call when needed. Thank you all at Sweetwater company.
